official_measurement_examples.name: Playing-field statutory consultation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Sport England's current planning-applications page states LPAs are required to consult it on planning applications for development affecting playing-field land under the 2015 Development Management Procedure Order.

official_measurement_examples.name: Playing pitch definition
official_measurement_examples.fact: Sport England quotes the 2015 Order definition of a playing pitch as a delineated area, with run-off, of 0.2 hectares or more used for specified pitch sports.

official_measurement_examples.name: Decision-maker distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: Sport England states it does not have legislative power to determine a planning application; the LPA remains the decision-maker.

official_measurement_examples.name: Pre-application advice status
official_measurement_examples.fact: Sport England's current page says its pre-application advice service was temporarily suspended from 1 July 2026 because of capacity constraints.

official_measurement_examples.name: Playing-fields policy exceptions
official_measurement_examples.fact: Sport England says its policy is to object to playing-field development unless one of five policy exceptions is met.

official_measurement_examples.name: Consultation performance
official_measurement_examples.fact: Sport England's playing-fields page reports almost 99% of statutory consultation requests receive a substantive response within 21 days or another agreed date.

official_measurement_examples.name: School land disposal register currency
official_measurement_examples.fact: DfE's school playing-field disposal decision register was updated 23 April 2026 and records approved/refused decisions separately.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2026 statutory-consultee reform proposal
official_measurement_examples.fact: Government's reform consultation proposed changes to Sport England's statutory-consultee role; consultation proposals must not be treated as enacted changes without later legal evidence.

core_rules: Sport England consultation is not planning permission
Sport England objection is not planning refusal
Sport England no objection is not planning permission
LPA remains the planning decision-maker
playing-field definition does not by itself decide planning merits
0.2-hectare playing-pitch threshold is not a development-capacity threshold
playing-field policy exception assessment is not automatic planning approval
meeting one Sport England exception is not proof every planning policy is satisfied
failure to meet an exception is not a Secretary of State decision
playing-field boundary is not a Land Registry title boundary
playing-field use is not proof of ownership
historic playing-field use must be evidenced
former playing field can remain relevant under policy depending on facts
school playing-field disposal consent is not planning permission
planning permission is not school-land disposal consent
DfE disposal approval is not planning permission
DfE disposal refusal is not planning refusal
School Playing Fields Advisory Panel recommendation is not Secretary of State decision
general consent order applicability must be evidenced
general consent is not planning permission
academy land transaction rules are distinct from maintained-school rules
Community Use Agreement is not planning permission
Community Use Agreement can be mitigation but does not itself discharge a planning condition
planning condition requiring community use must be evidenced
Sport England model condition is not an imposed condition
playing pitch strategy is not planning permission
needs assessment is not site allocation
sports facility calculator output is not parcel demand fact
facility planning model output is not planning decision
major development consultation advice is not planning refusal
300-dwelling consultation guidance is not a housing-capacity threshold
statutory consultation response target is not decision timing
temporary pre-application service suspension is not planning moratorium
statutory-consultee reform consultation is not enacted law
proposed notification regime is not current statutory duty without enacted evidence

surplus assessment must be robust and current

playing-field loss must not be inferred solely from map overlap
